enemies.name: Tactical Team Shooter
enemies.flavour_text: The Tactical Team is known for its tactical acumen and superb tactical equipment. Tactical Team Shooters equipped with thermal-imaging goggles can shoot with unerring accuracy in any condition, which is why they prefer to play in fog.

abilities.text: Shoots quicker and aims in a direction where there are no <Positional Barriers>

enemies.name: Elite Tactical Team Shooter
enemies.flavour_text: Elite members of the Tactical Team are said to have been baptized by fire in battle. Elite Tactical Team Shooters equipped with thermal-imaging goggles can shoot with unerring accuracy in any condition, which is why they prefer to play in fog.

abilities.text: Shoots quicker and aims in a direction where there are no <Positional Barriers>

enemies.name: Tactical Team Goalie
enemies.flavour_text: The Tactical Team is known for its tactical acumen and superb tactical equipment. Tactical Team Goalies equipped with binocular goggles can find any gaps in the opposing formation and kick the ball directly into the opposing goal.

abilities.text: Kickoffs are more powerful and aims in a direction where there are no <Positional Barriers>

enemies.name: Elite Tactical Team Goalie
enemies.flavour_text: Elite members of the Tactical Team are said to have been baptized by fire in battle. Elite Tactical Team Goalies equipped with binocular goggles can find any gaps in the opposing formation and kick the ball directly into the opposing goal.

abilities.text: Kickoffs are more powerful and aims in a direction where there are no <Positional Barriers>

enemies.name: Tactical Team Hitter
enemies.flavour_text: The Tactical Team is known for its tactical acumen and superb tactical equipment. Tactical Team Hitters equipped with vital monitors and warning systems can quickly locate opposing players attempting to hurt their teammates. Watch out—they have already found you.

abilities.text: Prioritizes searching for your units that dealt damage to opposing players

enemies.name: Elite Tactical Team Hitter
enemies.flavour_text: Elite members of the Tactical Team are said to have been baptized by fire in battle. Elite Tactical Team Hitters equipped with vital monitors and warning systems can quickly locate opposing players attempting to hurt their teammates. Watch out—they have already found you.

abilities.text: Prioritizes searching for your units that dealt damage to opposing players

enemies.name: Ball Mania Club Shooter
enemies.flavour_text: Members of the Ball Mania Club have such love for football that they have taken to the field dressed up as one. Ball is love, ball is life.

abilities.text: Dribbles for a period of time after touching the ball, increasing movement speed and taking up +1 Block

enemies.name: Ball Mania Club Honorary Shooter
enemies.flavour_text: Honorary members of the Ball Mania Club are one with the ball, physically and spiritually. Ball is love, ball is life.

abilities.text: Dribbles for a period of time after touching the ball, increasing movement speed and taking up +1 Block

enemies.name: Ball Mania Club Goalie
enemies.flavour_text: Members of the Ball Mania Club have such love for football that they have taken to the field dressed up as one. These goalies are so attuned to the ball that their passes never miss their mark.

abilities.text: Prioritizes kicking off the ball to a shooter

enemies.name: Ball Mania Club Honorary Goalie
enemies.flavour_text: Honorary members of the Ball Mania Club are one with the ball, physically and spiritually. These goalies are so attuned to the ball that their passes never miss their mark.

abilities.text: Prioritizes kicking off the ball to a shooter

enemies.name: Ball Mania Club Hitter
enemies.flavour_text: Members of the Ball Mania Club have such love for football that they have taken to the field dressed up as one. This love has slowly grown into a dangerous obsession. Careful, you may not want to let them see you kick their beloved ball.

abilities.text: Prioritizes searching for your units near the ball

enemies.name: Ball Mania Club Honorary Hitter
enemies.flavour_text: Honorary members of the Ball Mania Club are one with the ball, physically and spiritually. The ball is all that matters to them, nothing else. Careful, you may not want to let them see you kick their beloved ball.

abilities.text: Prioritizes searching for your units near the ball

enemies.name: Sportsmen United Shooter
enemies.flavour_text: For Sportsmen United, taking out all the opponent's players is the surest way to victory. The spikes on Sportsmen United Shooters make defending against them a daunting prospect.

abilities.text: Shots are more powerful, and the ball damages any of your units it touches

enemies.name: Sportsmen United Veteran Shooter
enemies.flavour_text: Sportsmen United veterans take it upon themselves to uphold the Positional Football tradition of taking out opposing players. The spikes on Sportsmen United Veteran Shooters make defending against them a daunting prospect.

abilities.text: Shots are more powerful, and the ball damages any of your units it touches

enemies.name: Sportsmen United Goalie
enemies.flavour_text: For Sportsmen United, taking out all the opponent's players is the surest way to victory. Sportsmen United Goalies may look mild-mannered, but they can be terrifying when angered.

abilities.text: When HP drops below 50%, gains increased ATK and DEF, temporarily stops defending the goal and starts attacking your players

enemies.name: Sportsmen United Veteran Goalie
enemies.flavour_text: Sportsmen United veterans take it upon themselves to uphold the Positional Football tradition of taking out opposing players. Sportsmen United Veteran Goalies may look mild-mannered, but they can be terrifying when angered.

abilities.text: When HP drops below 50%, gains increased ATK and DEF, temporarily stops defending the goal and starts attacking your players

enemies.name: Sportsmen United Hitter
enemies.flavour_text: For Sportsmen United, taking out all the opponent's players is the surest way to victory. No one knows if the hammers carried by Sportsmen United Hitters are really made of iron. No one wants to find out the hard way.

abilities.text: Prioritizes attacking your units, high ATK

enemies.name: Sportsmen United Veteran Hitter
enemies.flavour_text: Sportsmen United veterans take it upon themselves to uphold the Positional Football tradition of taking out opposing players. No one knows if the hammers carried by Sportsmen United Veteran Hitters are really made of iron. No one wants to find out the hard way.

abilities.text: Prioritizes attacking your units, high ATK

enemies.name: Leaking Beetleball
enemies.flavour_text: An Originium beetle plays the part of the football. It sucks in air to expand rapidly when it feels threatened, but this one seems to have a leak and keeps getting flatter as it rolls.

abilities.text: Becomes smaller when kicked, requiring less damage to move
Can only be blocked by a Goalkeeper or unit with Block Count of 3 or higher.

enemies.name: Bloated Beetleball
enemies.flavour_text: An Originium beetle plays the part of the football. It sucks in air to expand rapidly when it feels threatened, to scare away predators, but this just makes it all the more adorable to those present.

abilities.text: Becomes bigger when kicked, requiring more damage to move
Can only be blocked by a Goalkeeper or unit with Block Count of 3 or higher.

enemies.name: Will of the North Ball
enemies.flavour_text: A ball made in the image of the indomitable will of the north. Like its inspiration, its mere presence summons snow and ice. Anyone up for a game of ice hockey?

abilities.text: Leaves behind slippery ice on the ground
Can only be blocked by a Goalkeeper or unit with Block Count of 3 or higher.

enemies.name: Deep Sea Slider Ball
enemies.flavour_text: A ball made in the image of a strange sea creature. Like its inspiration, it excretes a mucous slime, but it is unable to slide smoothly. Instead, it gets stuck in its own slime all the time.

abilities.text: Leaves behind sticky slime on the ground
Can only be blocked by a Goalkeeper or unit with Block Count of 3 or higher.

enemies.name: Monument to Force
enemies.flavour_text: Monument that Engineering made from leftover materials. A few had too much time on their hands and gave it the ability to move. After all, there is nothing in the rules that addresses what to do if the ball gets flattened into a pancake.

abilities.text: Gains significantly increased ASPD for every 20% HP lost

enemies.name: Monument to Toughness
enemies.flavour_text: Monument that Engineering made from leftover materials. A few had too much time on their hands and gave it the ability to move. After all, no one is foolish enough to try to stop something this big on the field.

abilities.text: Takes up more Blocks for every 20% HP lost

enemies.name: Monument to Accuracy
enemies.flavour_text: Monument that Engineering made from leftover materials. A few had too much time on their hands and gave it the ability to move. With enough skill, even a club can penetrate the target like a javelin.

abilities.text: Gains significantly increased ATK for every 20% HP lost

enemies.name: Monument to Passion
enemies.flavour_text: Monument that Engineering made from leftover materials. A few had too much time on their hands and gave it the ability to move. The fire in its hand never goes out. If it did though, all it would need to do is relight it from its head.

abilities.text: Gains significantly increased ATK for every 20% HP lost

enemies.name: Monument to Swiftness
enemies.flavour_text: Monument that Engineering made from leftover materials. A few had too much time on their hands and gave it the ability to move. No one notices that the cleaning cart at the head of the course is faster than any of the race cars.

abilities.text: Gains significantly increased Movement Speed for every 20% HP lost
